script.text: After reuniting with Yubel, Jaden contemplated what to do next. Just then, a darkness crept over the world causing everyone but Jaden to vanish.
Impossible! All the people in the world have disappeared!?
Graawwww!
Jaden, the time has come for us to settle this.
Who are you!? Show yourself!
What... are you?
I am Nightshroud. Your people have been sent to MY world.
Nightshroud? Not you again! What are you after?
What am I after? I have no desires. I merely move with the will of the universe.
And the universe wills that your people live in darkness for eternity.
That's a lie!
Is it? Duel Monsters is a reflection of a duelist's soul. It can be of light or of darkness. If your heart remains in the light, peace will come to your world.
But most duelists have darkness in their hearts. And where there is darkness, there is Nightshroud.
No way! You're saying it's our fault that we brought you into our world!?
Exactly. I have no aspirations. It is the people that brought me here, and it is I that took them away.
It is the fault of your people for trying to use Duel Monsters for evil, feeding my energy!
Well tough guy, I don't duel for evil! I duel to stop the REAL monsters like you!
No one person can stop me.
I don't care! Even if I'm the last guy on Earth, I'll fight you to the end!
Hey, you're forgetting someone.
Yubel!
You are not alone. I am with you.
You fools. Two against one still does not change the odds.
Nightshroud, I'll show you that the bonds of friendship can overcome the odds!
